correctness.rationale: For a bounded T fixing a hyperplane with S=I-T rank one, S²=lambda S and ||S||>=1. If lambda<=1/5, the polynomial expression for T^4 and norm reverse triangle contradict ||T||<=1+r²/10^6. Otherwise P=I-S/lambda is a projection. The bounded-power Cesaro mean B_m=beta I+(1-beta)P with m=ceil(200/r) yields |beta|<r/19 and ||B_m||<1+r/2000, forcing ||P||<1+r<=c, contradicting the seed lower bound. For an l_infinity sum of finite seeds, choose a maximal coordinate of a nonzero kernel vector x, a norming functional on that coordinate, and the isometric graph embedding U with U(x_i)=x; the compressed map pi_i R U fixes a hyperplane and annihilates x_i. Indeed this compressed map is itself a hyperplane projection, yielding the stronger direct estimate ||R||>=min_i c_i and independently checking the weaker displayed uniform epsilon bound. Kobos 2015 Cor 1.2 proves alpha_j=(8(j+3)^5)^(-30(j+3)^2) for explicit E4 and E5, and Epperlein 2025 Thm 1.2 certifies c3>=1.01. The dimensions n>=6 split as 3a+4b, while n3,4,5 are seeded. Inspected exact-rational checker and independently verified the underlying algebra and parameter comparisons; no claim that the prior computer-assisted seed certificate was independently reproduced.
